title: Ianus
summary: Raleigh names Ianus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The Ianus of Italy, kept apart from Noah. A yeere of the World 2717 is printed as some other men's reckoning and was not entered. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
